Title: Woken up by a leg cramp at night? These 3 things could be why

Description:
Nearly 1 in 3 adults over 50 get jolted awake by a leg cramp at night, and it's not always just about getting older. Coffee, alcohol, and salty processed foods can all drain the magnesium, potassium, and calcium your muscles need to relax.

Watch to find out why each one triggers cramps, and what to swap in instead so you don't have to give them up completely.
